Job title: Part-Time Shift Lead

Location: Beverly & Martel

Reports to: Cafe Manager

FLSA Status: Non-exempt

Wage: $19.42/hr + tips ($23.50 - $26.50 per hour approximately)


The Shift Lead is responsible for supporting daily cafe operations while helping lead the team through busy and fast-paced shifts. This role acts as a key support partner to café leadership by driving hospitality standards, maintaining operational flow, coaching team members, and ensuring consistency in service and product quality. Shift Leads help set the tone on the floor through accountability, communication, and a hands-on leadership approach.


What You'll Do

Customer Service & Hospitality

  • Lead by example in delivering exceptional hospitality and upholding Alfred service standards at all times.
  • Provide confident, solutions-oriented leadership during shifts to ensure smooth and efficient cafe operations.
  • Create a welcoming environment for guests while serving as a role model for customer engagement and professionalism.
  • Address guest questions, concerns, and escalated situations thoughtfully and in alignment with Alfred Hospitality standards.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of all cafe offerings, including beverages, food items, and service standards, while supporting team knowledge and development.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Foster a collaborative, team-oriented culture built on accountability, communication, and recognition.
  • Support onboarding and training efforts through coaching, feedback, and reinforcement of operational standards.
  • Develop barista product knowledge, including coffee and tea origins, flavor profiles, and preparation techniques.
  • Build strong relationships with team members by understanding individual motivations, strengths, and opportunities for growth.
  • Assist management with staffing support, floor coverage adjustments, and shift flow decisions.
  • Delegate responsibilities effectively and ensure tasks are completed accurately and efficiently.
  • Support performance accountability and policy adherence in partnership with management.

Cafe Operations

  • Oversee daily cafe operations to ensure quality, consistency, cleanliness, and operational excellence.
  • Maintain an organized, stocked, and sanitary cafe environment throughout opening, mid, and closing shifts.
  • Ensure all food and beverage items are prepared according to Alfred standards for quality, presentation, and timeliness.
  • Support inventory management, product organization, and receiving deliveries.
  • Manage register operations, cash handling procedures, tip distribution, and employee timekeeping.
  • Conduct daily temperature logs and ensure compliance with health, safety, sanitation, and HACCP standards.
  • Utilize operational communication tools, including Slack, email, and Daily Cafe Logs, to maintain alignment across teams.
  • Anticipate cafe and guest needs by proactively monitoring the floor and adjusting workflow as needed.

Workplace Standards & Compliance

  • Promote a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment for both guests and employees.
  • Complete and document incident reports for employee or guest injuries and communicate incidents to management promptly.
  • Follow all company policies, procedures, and operational guidelines outlined in the Employee Handbook.
  • Support additional responsibilities and operational needs as assigned.
  • Describe the specific responsibilities and job functions of the role

Qualifications

  • Previous cafe, coffee, or restaurant experience preferred, but not required.
  • Passion for hospitality and creating exceptional guest experiences.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment while maintaining composure under pressure.
  • Positive attitude, strong work ethic, and willingness to learn and grow.
  • Flexibility to attend occasional trainings or team meetings outside of regularly scheduled shifts.
  • Maintain reliable attendance and consistent availability, including a minimum commitment of three shifts per week.
  • Full-time employees must maintain an average of 30 hours per week to retain full-time status.

Physical Requirements

  • Lift and carry up to 20 pounds without assistance.
  • Move quickly and efficiently throughout the cafe in a fast-paced environment.
  • Maintain strong close-range vision and attention to detail for drink preparation, cash handling, and order accuracy.
  • Bend, squat, reach, and perform cleaning, stocking, and other operational tasks as needed.
  • Remain on feet for extended periods throughout scheduled shifts.
  • Comfortably operate a POS system, cash register, or tablet device to accurately process customer orders and payments.
  • Demonstrate the hand dexterity and coordination needed to safely and efficiently operate espresso machines, steamers, grinders, and other cafe equipment while preparing beverages to company standards.

Benefits & Perks

  • Wage: $19.42/hr + tips
  • Free shift drinks and employee discounts
  • Growth and advancement opportunities
  • Open Path Collective - Therapy Membership Reimbursement
  • Employee referral bonuses
  • Creative and collaborative team culture

Job title: Cafe Manager in Training

Location: TBD

Reports to: Director of Retail

FLSA Status: Exempt

Wage: $70,304


The Cafe Manager in Training (CMIT) role is designed for emerging leaders preparing to take on an Alfred Cafe Manager position. CMITs gain hands-on experience leading teams, driving operational excellence, delivering exceptional hospitality, and supporting the overall performance of the cafe. Working closely with leadership, they build the skills, knowledge, and confidence needed to successfully manage an Alfred cafe while helping create an outstanding experience for both guests and team members.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment, leads with accountability and hospitality, and is passionate about building strong teams and exceptional customer experiences.

What You'll Do

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop team members through ongoing feedback, training, and performance management.
  • Foster a positive, accountable, and team-oriented work environment that reflects Alfred’s values and culture.
  • Support recruiting, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, and ongoing employee development in partnership with executive leadership.
  • Ensure all team members are properly trained in operational procedures, hospitality standards, and product knowledge.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and coach employees toward growth and improvement.
  • Address employee performance concerns professionally and document developmental plans when necessary.
  • Lead by example and set the standard for professionalism, urgency, communication, and hospitality.

Customer Experience & Hospitality

  • Uphold and model exceptional hospitality standards, ensuring every guest receives a welcoming and consistent experience.
  • Resolve customer concerns proactively and professionally while maintaining a calm, solutions-oriented approach.
  • Ensure team members maintain strong knowledge of Alfred products, services, and menu offerings.
  • Create a cafe environment that is warm, inclusive, efficient, and reflective of the Alfred brand.

Operations & Store Management

  • Oversee daily cafe operations to ensure efficiency, cleanliness, organization, and consistency across all shifts.
  • Manage scheduling and labor planning to support business needs while maintaining labor targets.
  • Oversee cash handling, deposits, POS operations, opening/closing procedures, and store administrative functions.
  • Maintain inventory levels, product organization, and ordering processes while minimizing waste and controlling costs.
  • Ensure compliance with all company policies, operational procedures, food safety standards, and health regulations.
  • Maintain high standards for store appearance, merchandising, equipment maintenance, and overall operational readiness.
  • Utilize operational tools and communication platforms, including Slack, email, and reporting systems, to maintain alignment and accountability.

Financial Performance & Business Operations

  • Support sales growth and profitability by managing labor, inventory, supplies, and operational expenses.
  • Execute promotions, seasonal launches, and business initiatives effectively within the cafe.
  • Monitor operational performance and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, customer experience, and store profitability.

Product Quality & Standards

  • Ensure all beverages, food items, and retail offerings consistently meet Alfred quality and presentation standards.
  • Maintain deep knowledge of coffee, tea, and food offerings, including origins, blends, preparation methods, and flavor profiles.
  • Train and educate team members on product standards and hospitality expectations.
  • Conduct regular quality checks of beverages and food products throughout shifts.

Safety & Compliance

  • Promote safe work practices and maintain a clean, organized, and food-safe environment.
  • Identify and resolve operational inconsistencies, maintenance issues, and safety concerns proactively.
  • Document employee or customer incidents and support investigations when necessary.
  • Ensure all team members adhere to company policies and procedures outlined in Alfred handbooks and operational manuals.

What You’ll Need

  • 3+ years of retail, hospitality, or cafe management experience preferred.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and team development skills.
  • Ability to multitask, problem-solve, and lead effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Passion for hospitality, team culture, and customer experience.
  • Flexibility to work mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, overtime, and special events as needed.
  • Proficiency with written communication, email etiquette, and operational communication platforms.
  • Ability to remain responsive through Slack, email, phone, and text communication.
  • Reliable transportation and a valid driver’s license.

Physical Requirements

  • Able to lift up to 20 pounds without assistance.
  • Move quickly and efficiently from one area of the café to another.
  • Ability to hear and communicate effectively in English.
  • Good vision, including the ability to see details at close range.
  • Flexibility to bend and squat as necessary to perform cleaning and stocking tasks.
  • Ability to stand for extended periods and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Capable of operating a cash register or tablet device to enter customer orders accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to speak clearly and project voice to effectively communicate with customers and team members.

 

Benefits & Perks

  • Base salary: $70,304/ annually
  • Medical, Dental, & Vision coverage
  • Paid time off accruals
  • 401(k) eligibility after 12 months of employment
  • Annual cafe performance bonuses & raises
  • Free shift drinks and employee discounts
  • Growth and advancement opportunities
  • Open Path Collective - Therapy Membership Reimbursement
  • Employee referral bonuses
  • Creative and collaborative team culture

JOB TITLE: Part-Time Barista

LOCATION: Canon Drive

REPORTS TO: Cafe Manager

FLSA STATUS: Non-exempt

WAGE: $18.67/hr + tips ($22.50 - $25.50/hr approximately)


The Barista is responsible for creating an exceptional guest experience through outstanding hospitality, product quality, and efficient cafe operations. This role prepares high-quality coffee, tea, and food offerings while fostering a welcoming and energetic environment for both guests and team members. The ideal candidate is collaborative, adaptable, and passionate about hospitality, teamwork, and creating memorable customer experiences.

What You'll Bring

Customer Experience

  • Welcome guests with warmth and hospitality while delivering an elevated customer experience.
  • Guide customers through beverage and food offerings, answer questions thoughtfully, and build genuine rapport.
  • Handle phone inquiries, accurately process orders, and support mobile ordering operations.
  • Maintain a calm, professional, and welcoming presence during high-volume periods.

Beverage Preparation & Food Service

  • Prepare consistent, high-quality beverages and food items in accordance with Alfred recipes and standards.
  • Operate, clean, and maintain coffee equipment while ensuring all beverage and food preparation areas remain clean, organized, and sanitary.
  • Develop knowledge of coffee and tea origins, flavor profiles, and preparation methods.

Team Collaboration

  • Foster a positive team environment through active listening, clear communication, and a solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Partner with leadership and teammates to address operational needs and maintain consistency across shifts.

Cafe Operations

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and fully stocked café environment throughout each shift.
  • Assist with inventory, restocking, deliveries, and overall café upkeep.
  • Adhere to all policies and procedures outlined in Company’s employee handbook.
  • Additional tasks that may be assigned to meet company goals.

Safety & Compliance

  • Follow all company procedures related to food safety, sanitation, hygiene, and café organization.
  • Report safety hazards, incidents, or operational concerns to the Management.

Qualifications

  • Previous cafe, coffee, or restaurant experience is preferred, but not required.
  • Passion for hospitality and creating positive customer experiences in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative team setting while working efficiently under pressure.
  • Positive attitude, strong work ethic, and eagerness to learn and grow.
  • Flexibility to attend quarterly team meetings, trainings, or company events that may occasionally take place outside of regular scheduled shifts.
  • Maintain reliable attendance and consistent availability, including a minimum commitment of three shifts per week.

Physical Requirements

  • Lift and carry up to 20 pounds without assistance.
  • Move quickly and efficiently throughout the café in a fast-paced environment.
  • Maintain strong close-range vision and attention to detail for drink preparation, cash handling, and order accuracy.
  • Bend, squat, reach, and perform cleaning, stocking, and other operational tasks as needed.
  • Remain on feet for extended periods throughout scheduled shifts.
  • Comfortably operate a POS system, cash register, or tablet device to accurately process customer orders and payments.
  • Demonstrate the hand dexterity and coordination needed to safely and efficiently operate espresso machines, steamers, grinders, and other café equipment while preparing beverages to company standards.

Benefits & Perks

  • Wage: $18.67/ hr+ tips ($22.50 - $25.50/hr approximately)
  • Free shift drinks and employee discounts
  • Open Path Collective - Therapy Membership Reimbursement
  • Employee referral bonuses
  • Growth and advancement opportunities
  • Creative and collaborative team culture

Job title: Facilities Manager

Location: Van Nuys, CA

Reports to: Vice President of Retail Operations

FLSA Status: Exempt

Compensation: $75,000 - $85,000


The Facilities Manager serves as a key partner to Alfred’s Operations team, overseeing the maintenance, repair, cleanliness, and overall functionality of our 27+ cafes and facilities across Los Angeles.

This role is responsible for keeping our physical spaces operating at a high standard from cafe equipment and HVAC systems to preventative maintenance, signage installations, cleaning services, and day-to-day facility needs. You’ll manage Alfred’s internal facilities team, beverage equipment technician, and external vendors, while regularly visiting cafe locations to proactively identify maintenance needs and ensure issues are resolved quickly and effectively

What You'll do

Facilities Operations & Maintenance

  • Oversee day-to-day facilities operations, maintenance, and repairs across Alfred’s headquarters, warehouse, and cafe locations.
  • Coordinate preventative maintenance and repairs for cafe equipment, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, fixtures, and other building systems.
  • Manage service requests through completion, prioritizing issues based on urgency and operational impact.
  • Oversee signage installations, facility projects, and maintenance support for new cafe openings and renovations
  • Partner with cafe managers and Operations leadership to identify needs, resolve recurring issues, and minimize disruption to operations.

Team & Vendor Management

  • Manage internal facilities and maintenance team and beverage equipment technician, including scheduling, preventative maintenance, service quality, and follow-through.
  • Oversee cleaning services and ensure established cleanliness and facility standards are consistently met.
  • Manage relationships with contractors and facilities vendors, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and installation partners.
  • Monitor vendor performance, costs, and response times and hold partners accountable to service expectations.

Facilities Planning & Process Improvement

  • Maintain preventative maintenance schedules, service records, facilities procedures, and vendor information.
  • Monitor facilities expenses and partner with Operations and Finance on budgets, invoices, and repair-versus-replacement decisions.
  • Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve preventative maintenance, response times, equipment reliability, and overall facilities operations.

What You'll Bring

  • 3+ years of facilities management, maintenance operations, property management, or related experience; multi-location retail or hospitality experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing facilities teams, contractors, and third-party vendors.
  • Working knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, commercial equipment, preventative maintenance, and general building systems.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and problem-solving skills with a proactive, hands-on approach.
  • Ability to manage facilities budgets, vendor relationships, competing priorities, and repair-versus-replacement decisions.
  • Ability to travel between Alfred locations throughout Los Angeles, respond to urgent facilities needs when necessary.
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $75,000 - $85,000 annual salary
  • Medical, Dental, & Vision insurance packages
  • Vacation PTO & Sick time accrual
  • 401(k) plan (after 12 months of employment)
  • Monthly phone reimbursement
  • Employee discounts
  • Free coffee & pastry during work hours
  • Monthly coffee/tea bag take home
  • Open Path Collective Therapy reimbursement

Job title: Payroll Specialist

Location: Los Angeles, CA

Reports to: Director of People

FLSA Status: Non-exempt

Compensation: $27 - $32 per hour (full-time)

The Payroll Specialist serves as a key partner across Alfred’s People, Operations, and Finance functions, owning the day-to-day administration and accuracy of payroll for employees across our corporate and cafe locations.

This role is responsible for processing payroll, reviewing timekeeping data, maintaining accurate employee records, resolving payroll discrepancies, and supporting compliance with applicable wage-and-hour requirements. You’ll work closely with managers and employees to identify issues before they become problems and ensure payroll information is complete, accurate, and submitted on time.

What You'll do

Payroll Administration & Compliance

  • Own the end-to-end payroll processing cycle, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time.
  • Review payroll and timekeeping data, including hours, overtime, PTO, sick time, meal premiums, benefit deductions, reimbursements, and other earnings.
  • Maintain accurate payroll records and support new-hire setup, employee changes, offboarding, audits, and year-end activities.
  • Review payroll registers, identify discrepancies, and process adjustments, off-cycle payments, and final pay as needed.
  • Support payroll compliance and required reporting across federal, California, Wisconsin, and applicable local requirements, including EEO reporting, 401(k) reporting and filings, and employee loan administration and oversight. 
  • Manage and resolve payroll-related tax notices and inquiries, including researching discrepancies, coordinating necessary corrections, and ensuring IRS and other agency notices are addressed and closed out in a timely manner.

Employee & Manager Support

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for employee and manager payroll questions and resolve issues related to pay, timekeeping, deductions, direct deposit, taxes, and PTO.
  • Partner with cafe managers and department leaders to resolve payroll and timekeeping issues ahead of deadlines.
  • Communicate payroll procedures, deadlines, and expectations clearly and consistently.
  • Handle employee and compensation information with a high degree of confidentiality and discretion.

Payroll Systems & Process Improvement

  • Maintain and regularly audit payroll and employee information within HRIS.
  • Maintain payroll processes and procedures while identifying opportunities to improve accuracy, efficiency, and manager training.
  • Support payroll reporting, system updates, and troubleshooting in partnership with HR, Finance, Operations, and leadership.

What You'll Bring

  • 2 - 4 years of payroll, accounting, HR operations, or related experience; experience supporting a multi-location or high-volume hourly workforce strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience processing payroll and reviewing timekeeping data, with working knowledge of federal and California wage-and-hour requirements.
  • Strong numerical aptitude, attention to detail, and ability to identify and resolve payroll discrepancies.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to manage deadlines and explain payroll information clearly.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information, with the ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $27 - $32 per hour (full-time)
  • Medical, Dental, & Vision insurance packages
  • Vacation PTO & Sick time accrual
  • 401(k) plan (after 12 months of employment)
  • Monthly phone reimbursement
  • Employee discounts
  • Free coffee & pastry during work hours
  • Monthly coffee/tea bag take home
  • Open Path Collective Therapy reimbursement

Job title: People Operations Manager

Location: Los Angeles, CA

Reports to: Director of People

FLSA Status: Exempt

Wage: $80,000 - $90,000


The People Operations Manager serves as a trusted People partner to Alfred’s leaders, managers, and employees. This role owns the leaves and accommodations process and partners with the Director of People on employee relations matters, while advising and coaching managers and helping ensure consistent, compliant People practices across the organization. 

This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable navigating complex and sensitive employee matters while also building strong relationships with teams at every level. The ideal candidate brings sound judgment, empathy, accountability, and a practical approach to solving People challenges in a fast-paced, multi-location environment.

What You'll Do

Employee Relations & Investigations

  • Conduct timely and thorough workplace investigations for low-to-mid-level concerns, including interviews, documentation, findings, and recommended next steps.
  • Partner with the Director of People on complex or high-risk employee matters, assessing risk and recommending thoughtful, consistent, and compliant solutions.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential documentation of employee relations matters and ensure appropriate follow-through through resolution.

Leaves, Accommodations, & Compliance

  • Own end-to-end management of leaves of absence and accommodation requests, serving as the primary subject matter expert and administrator. 
  • Help ensure compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws and translate requirements into practical processes for managers and teams.
  • Support the consistent implementation and interpretation of company policies, procedures, and People programs across Alfred locations.
  • Identify potential areas of employee-related risk and escalate or recommend appropriate action when needed.
  • Stay current on relevant employment requirements and help ensure People practices evolve alongside regulatory changes.

People Operational Excellence

  • Partner cross-functionally with Recruiting, Payroll, Operations, Training, and other teams to create a consistent employee experience throughout the employee lifecycle.
  • Support onboarding, performance management, employee transitions, and offboarding as needed.
  • Maintain accurate employee records and support strong HRIS data integrity and documentation practices.
  • Support development and improvement of People processes, policies, manager resources, and tools as Alfred continues to grow.
  • Advance broader People initiatives, special projects, and organizational priorities in partnership with the Director of People.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3+ years of Human Resources or People Operations management experience supporting hourly, hospitality, retail, or multi-location teams strongly preferred.
  • Strong working knowledge of California employment practices, including wage and hour, leaves of absence, accommodations, performance management, and employee relations.
  • Experience conducting workplace investigations and managing sensitive employee matters from intake through resolution.
  • Confidence coaching managers through performance concerns, corrective action, difficult conversations, and other complex employee matters.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to independently assess situations, identify potential risk, recommend solutions, and recognize when escalation is appropriate.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and credibility with employees and leaders at all levels.
  • Adaptable, solutions-oriented, and comfortable being a visible, hands-on People partner to teams across Alfred’s cafes.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base salary: $80,00 - $90,000 annually
  • Medical, Dental, & Vision insurance packages
  • Vacation paid time off and sick time accruals
  • 401(k) eligibility after 12 months of employment
  • Monthly phone reimbursement
  • Free drinks and employee discounts
  • Growth and advancement opportunities
  • Open Path Collective Therapy Reimbursement
